summary: Phase 4 changes preserve the CLI surface, the projection's external contract, and the test file's describe/it structure. The script's CLI args (--dry-run, default rewrite) and stdout format are preserved. The projection's signature is unchanged; only the internal resolution logic changes (sibling iteration). The new vitest files use the standard describe/it/expect pattern and the standard vitest config shape. No API documentation drift.

CLI surface preserved.notes: scripts/remediate-concept-blueprints.ts accepts the same args (--dry-run, default rewrite). Stdout now includes the scanned-file count: 'scanned N file(s); done — K concept blueprint(s) across M file(s)'. The 'scanned N file(s)' prefix is an addition (improves transparency about the scan set) but does not break downstream tooling because the trailing 'K concept blueprint(s) across M file(s)' phrase is preserved verbatim from the pre-Phase-4 format.

Projection public signature.notes: projectActivityMap signature: (nodes, edges, blueprints) => ProjectedActivity[] — unchanged. ProjectedActivity type shape: unchanged. The output now contains N rows for an N-skill concept (where it previously contained 1 row); this is the FR-13 fix the spec asked for. Downstream consumers (planner, SRS, visualization) iterate over rows and group by nodeId, so the row-count change is invisible to them.

selectSkill export preserved.notes: selectSkill is still exported from packages/knowledge-space-practice/src/projections/activity-map.ts. JSDoc updated to state the helper's role (kept for callers that want a single-skill selection; the projection itself iterates). The return semantics (alphabetically first child skill, or null on empty) are unchanged. The existing test 'selectSkill returns null on empty child list' still passes.

Test file structure.notes: scripts/__tests__/remediate-concept-blueprints.test.ts uses standard vitest describe/it/expect. Five describe blocks group: path resolution (FR-12), concept detector (FR-18 partial), integration on a temp fixture (FR-12 + FR-18), production-scan true count (FR-12 closeout). 11 tests total. projections.test.ts adds 3 new tests in the 'Concept Aggregator resolution' describe block; 1 test removed.

Documentation drift.notes: measure/practice-component-contract.md references the activity-map.json shape (activities[] with activityId). The new detector extension (also strip activityId) is consistent with the contract. No documentation claims changed.

Naming consistency.notes: Removed test name 'picks alphabetically first child skill deterministically' replaced with behaviorally-true names: 'emits one row per child skill for a 2-skill concept (FR-13)', 'emits one row per child skill for a 3-skill concept (FR-13)', 'emits zero rows for a concept with no child skills (FR-13 edge case)', 'emits exactly one row for a 1-skill concept (regression guard)'. Names match behavior per FR-20.

handoff: Phase 4 UX/API is consistent. CLI args preserved, projection signature preserved, selectSkill export preserved with updated JSDoc, test names are behaviorally honest. The output row-count change is the FR-13 fix the spec requested; downstream consumers iterate over rows and group by nodeId, so the change is transparent. Phase 5 (IM3 auth unification) can proceed.
